title: Count Substrings with Only One Distinct Letter
description: Given a string, return the total number of substrings that consist of only one distinct letter.

steps.note: Initialize count to 0 and current block length to 1.
Start loop at index 1. s[1] ('a') is equal to s[0] ('a').
Loop to index 2. s[2] ('b') is not equal to s[1] ('a').
Sequence broken. Add (2 * 3) / 2 = 3 to count. Reset length to 1.
Loop finishes at index 3. i == s.length.
Add (1 * 2) / 2 = 1 to count. Final count is 4.
